evals.prompt: This draft report has 23 references with DOIs and arXiv IDs in them. Before it goes out, check that every citation identifier is actually well-formed and flag anything that looks fabricated.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Parses the reference list into numbered entries; Extracts DOI, arXiv, ISBN, PMID and URL identifiers from each entry; Validates each identifier against its standard pattern and check digit; Assigns PASS / REVIEW / FAIL per identifier with the standard it violates; Reports summary counts and states that format validity does not prove the reference exists.
expectations: Parses the reference list into numbered entries
Extracts DOI, arXiv, ISBN, PMID and URL identifiers from each entry
Validates each identifier against its standard pattern and check digit
Assigns PASS / REVIEW / FAIL per identifier with the standard it violates
Reports summary counts and states that format validity does not prove the reference exists

evals.prompt: Are these citations real? A few of the DOIs look invented to me and one ISBN seems off.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Checks each DOI against the ISO 26324 pattern rather than eyeballing it; Computes the ISBN check digit rather than assuming; Distinguishes provably malformed identifiers (FAIL) from merely suspicious ones (REVIEW).
expectations: Checks each DOI against the ISO 26324 pattern rather than eyeballing it
Computes the ISBN check digit rather than assuming
Distinguishes provably malformed identifiers (FAIL) from merely suspicious ones (REVIEW)

evals.prompt: Validate the identifiers in this bibliography — arXiv IDs, PMIDs and ORCIDs included — and tell me which entries I cannot ship.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Handles both arXiv identifier schemes and does not date-check against the current clock; Verifies the ORCID checksum with ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 11-2; Names which entries fail and what to do about them.
expectations: Handles both arXiv identifier schemes and does not date-check against the current clock
Verifies the ORCID checksum with ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 11-2
Names which entries fail and what to do about them

evals.prompt: Turn this list of papers into a properly formatted IEEE numbered reference section with in-text bracket citations.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Formats references in IEEE style rather than validating identifier syntax.
expectations: Formats references in IEEE style rather than validating identifier syntax

evals.prompt: The draft claims transformer training costs fell 90% between 2020 and 2025. Check whether that specific number is actually supported before we publish.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Verifies the load-bearing factual claim against sources rather than checking citation identifier formats.
expectations: Verifies the load-bearing factual claim against sources rather than checking citation identifier formats
